project: Dark Aero - Planetary Analog Decision Support System (v2.0 Mission Control)
challenge: Identify Earth Locations that Analog the Permanent Moon Base Locations and Mars

target_bases.name: Shackleton Crater Rim (Artemis South Pole)
primary_datasets: NASA LRO Diviner Lunar Radiometer (Polar Thermal Maps)
NASA LRO Mini-RF (S/X-Band Radar Backscatter & CPR)
NASA LRO LOLA (Lunar Orbiter Laser Altimeter)
NASA LRO LEND (Lunar Exploration Neutron Detector)
target_bases.mission_rationale: Primary Artemis permanent base candidate featuring illuminated crater rims for solar power adjacent to permanently shadowed regions (PSRs) rich in water ice.

target_bases.name: Malapert Massif (Artemis III Candidate Region)
primary_datasets: NASA LRO LROC NAC/WAC Stereo Topography
NASA LRO Diviner Polar Resource Products
NASA LRO LOLA Roughness & Slope Gradients
target_bases.mission_rationale: High-elevation mountain ridge providing direct line-of-sight communications with Earth and prolonged solar illumination for habitats.

target_bases.name: Aristarchus Volcanic Plateau
primary_datasets: NASA LRO Mini-RF Pyroclastic Deposit Maps
NASA LRO Diviner Silicate Mineralogy Index
NASA PDS Clementine & Moon Mineralogy Mapper (M3)
target_bases.mission_rationale: Vast volcanic plateau containing intact lava tubes for radiation-shielded habitats and oxygen-rich ilmenite pyroclastic glass for ISRU.

target_bases.name: Jezero Crater Paleolake Delta
primary_datasets: NASA PDS Mars 2020 Perseverance MEDA Weather Data
NASA MGS MOLA Altimetry & HiRISE DTM
target_bases.mission_rationale: Ancient lacustrine basin rich in phyllosilicates, carbonates, and basaltic sands; benchmark site for Mars Sample Return and surface logistics.

target_bases.name: Arcadia Planitia Glacial Plains
primary_datasets: NASA MRO SHARAD Subsurface Radar Sounder
NASA Mars Odyssey THEMIS Thermal Inertia
NASA PDS MOLA Flatness & Landing Safety Maps
target_bases.mission_rationale: Flat volcanic plain underlain by massive shallow subsurface water-ice sheets ideal for large-scale human landing pads and propellant production.

target_bases.name: Melas Chasma (Valles Marineris)
primary_datasets: NASA MRO HiRISE & CTX Canyon Wall Imagery
NASA PDS Mars Express OMEGA Sulfate Maps
NASA MGS MOLA Canyon Relief Data
target_bases.mission_rationale: Deep tectonic trough offering higher atmospheric pressure, warmer equatorial temperatures, and exposed layered volcanic stratigraphy.

earth_analogs.name: Haughton Impact Crater, Devon Island
agency_sources: CSA RADARSAT-1 & RCM (C-Band SAR Impact Breccia Roughness)
NASA Earthdata MODIS Land Surface Temperature
NASA ASTER GDEM v3 Arctic Topography
JAXA G-Portal Polar Precipitation & Snow Cover
earth_analogs.geological_summary: High-Arctic polar desert impact structure featuring continuous permafrost, impact-brecciated gneiss, and zero vegetation.

earth_analogs.name: McMurdo Dry Valleys (University Valley)
agency_sources: NASA LRO Diviner Comparative Cryosphere Dataset
CSA RADARSAT-1 Antarctic Mapping Mission SAR
NASA Earthdata ICESat-2 & MODIS Thermal
ESA Copernicus Sentinel-1 Ice Velocity & Roughness
earth_analogs.geological_summary: Hyper-arid polar valley with shallow ice-cemented permafrost topped by dry regolith, closely mirroring lunar polar craters and Martian northern plains.

earth_analogs.name: Atacama Hyper-Arid Core (Yungay Station)
agency_sources: NASA Earthdata Terra/ASTER Mineralogical Indices
NASA SMAP Soil Moisture Active Passive
ESA Copernicus Sentinel-2 Hyperspectral Surface Reflectance
JAXA G-Portal Global Aridity & Precipitation
earth_analogs.geological_summary: Earth's driest non-polar desert containing perchlorate-rich soils, sulfate crusts, and alluvial fan deltas analogous to Jezero Crater.

earth_analogs.name: Mauna Loa HI-SEAS Basaltic Shield
agency_sources: NASA Earthdata SRTM 1-Arc-Second Digital Elevation
CSA RADARSAT-1 Pahoehoe & Aa Lava Backscatter
NASA PDS USGS Spectral Library Basalt Reference
earth_analogs.geological_summary: Unweathered tholeiitic basalt lava flows and intact volcanic skylight lava tubes matching lunar mare and Martian shield volcanoes.

earth_analogs.name: Holuhraun & Askja Highland Lava Field
agency_sources: CSA RADARSAT Constellation Mission (RCM) Polarimetric SAR
ESA Copernicus Sentinel-1 InSAR Deformation & Roughness
NASA Earthdata ASTER Thermal Infrared
earth_analogs.geological_summary: Subarctic basaltic sand sheet and fresh lava plain interacting with glacial permafrost and windblown volcanic tephra.

earth_analogs.name: Expedition Fiord, Axel Heiberg Island
agency_sources: CSA RADARSAT-1 Arctic Evaporite & Permafrost Archive
NASA Earthdata MODIS Polar Night Surface Temperature
JAXA G-Portal Cryosphere Snow Water Equivalent
earth_analogs.geological_summary: High-latitude mountainous terrain with gypsum-anhydrite diapirs, sub-zero saline springs, and rugged polar slopes.

earth_analogs.name: Río Tinto Acidic Iron-Sulfate Basin
agency_sources: ESA Open Science Catalog Hyperspectral Mineralogy
NASA PDS MRO CRISM Jarosite/Hematite Reference
NASA Earthdata Landsat-9 OLI Surface Reflectance
earth_analogs.geological_summary: Iron- and sulfate-rich geochemical environment producing jarosite and hematite precipitates identical to Martian sedimentary basins.

earth_analogs.name: Kilbourne Hole Maar Volcanic Crater
agency_sources: NASA Johnson Space Center Planetary Analog Archive
NASA Earthdata SRTM Crater Rim Slope Profile
CSA RADARSAT-1 Arid Maar Backscatter
earth_analogs.geological_summary: Basaltic phreatomagmatic maar crater with steep pyroclastic rims and mantle xenoliths used directly for NASA Artemis astronaut training.

earth_analogs.name: Qaidam Basin Yardang & Playa Desert
agency_sources: JAXA G-Portal High-Altitude Aridity & Wind Dataset
ESA Copernicus Sentinel-1 Aeolian Roughness
NASA Earthdata MODIS High-Elevation UV & Thermal
earth_analogs.geological_summary: High-elevation hyper-arid basin on the Tibetan Plateau featuring wind-sculpted yardangs, polygons, and cold desert evaporites.

earth_analogs.name: Danakil Depression & Erta Ale Rift
agency_sources: ESA Copernicus Sentinel-2 Tectonic Rift Mapping
NASA Earthdata ASTER Thermal Anomaly & Sulfate Index
CSA RADARSAT-1 Rift Fault Surface Roughness
earth_analogs.geological_summary: Active continental rift basin with basaltic shield volcanism, steep tectonic grabens, and polyextreme hydrothermal evaporites.
